name: codex-prototype
description: CodEX Prototype — minimal code rooms with AI explainer, chat and explicit push/pull sync.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codex/shared && npm run build -w @codex/realtime && npm run build -w @codex/web && npm run build -w @codex/cleanup
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @codex/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:web dev:realtime
